about_the_game:
Old-school grid-paper ship combat game, reborn in deep space — with deeper rules and with a space adventure. *

It’s not just “find the ship” anymore. It’s a tactical, turn-based grid battle fought across the stars — with customizable ships, a wide arsenal of weapons and gear, and varied enemy fleets to keep each fight fresh.

Same one-click clarity — but you’ll have to think before you shoot.

How it plays

  • Shields & armor. A ship cell isn’t always destroyed in one hit — some take more than one.

  • Bonus Move. You only earn a Bonus Move when the target cell is destroyed (HP = 0), not on every hit — plan your shots.

  • Weapons vary in damage, ammo, cooldowns, and special effects — some can even grant a second shot in the same move. Pick the right tool for the job.

  • Hull size. Size isn’t a drawback now: bolt on weapons and armor to make large ships truly worthwhile in combat.

  • Commanders & abilities. Fleet leaders grant abilities that can influence the course of battle.

This demo (a vertical slice of the core game) shows how the new rules change the flow of combat.

What’s included

  • Tutorial mini-campaign.
    A story-driven introduction that explains new mechanics through several linked battles, while introducing a few characters and commander abilities.

  • Fleet Builder.
    Build your own fleet: select hulls, install weapons and support gear, and test your custom configurations in combat.

  • Skirmish mode.
    Four different battles.

  • Adjustable AI difficulty.
    After finishing the tutorial, you can tune the enemy AI and challenge yourself at any skill level.

* Not affiliated with or endorsed by any third-party board or video game brands.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher, 64/32-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Built with Godot 4 (2D), Compatibility (OpenGL 3.3) renderer
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher, 64/32-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Built with Godot 4 (2D), Compatibility (OpenGL 3.3) renderer

short_description: Old-school grid-paper game, reborn in deep space. Deeper rules, same one-click clarity—and interstellar adventures. Outfit ships with weapons, armor, shields, and gear, and choose commander abilities. Roam the galaxy from its lawless outskirts to its heart.
